profile_text.body:
RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC. is a public company headquartered in Las Vegas, NV, with ticker RR and SEC CIK 0001963685. It is also listed under the alias RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC-CL B. No litigation is listed for the company in Nevada, and no products or MCP servers are listed for the company.

The company's website, rolls-royce.com, presents content for Rolls-Royce. The site describes Rolls-Royce as a developer of complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea, and on land, and states that it has been at the forefront of innovation for more than 100 years. The site reports that Rolls-Royce completed a $1 Billion investment in Indiana, and that Reliance Industries and Rolls-Royce announced a strategic intent to partner on India's Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft programme. It also states that Rolls-Royce, the United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory, and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency will co-operate on advanced nuclear technologies, and that Rolls-Royce SMR has multiple contractual commitments to deliver SMR units in Europe after signing a contract with CEZ Group.

The website material does not describe AI-specific products.
